notes.title: Fantastic Findings Demo Update! New Camera System & More!
notes.notes:
[p]Hi Jolly Folks!

A new update is out for Fantastic Findings Hidden Seasons Demo, 
Many of you have provided great feedback on the first version of the Demo. We took lots of feedback to heart and implemented it together with many other ideas!

The new camera system allowed for Keyboard input, WASD and Arrowkeys! - But if you want to stick with only-mouse controls, that is still possible to use, without any extra settings!

We also added a bunch of quality of life changes to the game; locking items which are unavailable at the time or locked away; as well as showcasing a number of the bundles, where items are still missing!

Not to fear! Lots more new features and levels are making it into the full game!

We hope everyone enjoys the new changes to the demo. Please post your feedback on our Discord.

Kind Regards - we hope you will have fun playing our game!
Line & Mike 
Shapeshift Entertainment

[url="https://discord.gg/aCk8pRnhSM" style="button"]Discord[/url][/p]

notes.title: Fantastic Findings Hidden Seasons - DEMO IS LIVE!
notes.notes:
[p]Get into the holiday season early this year! The demo of Fantastic Findings is live! Try the first 2 levels of the game today - Wishlist the game - provide your feedback so we can make the game even better for you!

We look forward to all the feedback provided and aim to fix as much as possible before the release. The feedback can be provided on our Discord or on our steam community pages. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45605927/0dcca1502a3974ed4140af9995f0bf3091a89005.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Fantastic Findings showcased in upcoming Charity Stream!
notes.notes:
Fantastic Findings first ever public showcase is ready! The playtest will be played by Lydbutton on her twitch stream this weekend! Fantastic findings is showcased 1 PM and is joining the good cause to fight Lupus!

Tune in on:  [url=http://twitch.tv/lydlbutton]Lydbutton on Twitch[/url]

This all came into play over on [url=https://bsky.app/profile/bering.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url] where frequent updates on the development are posted. This caught the eye of other indie developers participating in the stream who go me on board this epic streamer hype train!
